desc:
another grabpack test type of game, but in blocky style :P
THIS GAME IS IN BETA VERSION ⚠️

Controls on PC 💻
F = Flashlight
V = Blacklight
1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 = Change Hands
Left CTRL or C = Crouch
LeftShift = Sprint
7 = Settings Menu
R = Hands Wheel
B = Emotes Menu
G = Backpack

Controls on CONSOLE 🎮
LT / L2 -- RT / R2 = Shoot Hands and Hold
B / Circle = Crouch
LSB / R3 = Run
DPadRight = Quick Change Hands
DPadDown = Flashlight
DPadLeft = Blacklight
Y / Triangle = Hands Wheel
